_about: Agent A. The mastery gauge in every fight: reel with the tension in the sweet band, steer against the fish, bow at its leaps and counter its powers to fill it. A fuller gauge tires the fish faster (shorter fights) and upgrades the catch. Grades lock in once reached. Great and Perfect fights build a lucky streak that makes rarer fish bite on the next casts. 'surge': once per fight, reaching Good/Great may start a surge: three closing rings, tap as each meets the fish. 3 hits = the island's elemental variant (it gets its superpower), 2 hits = gilded. 'taunt': while the lure waits, tap on the pulse to twitch it; on-beat twitches build the taunt (rarer fish notice from further, curious fish strike sooner, bigger size roll), off-beat or frantic taps spook; a full taunt may call a rare fish. Hold to reel in. 'minigames': snag = the line catches, swipe the arrows shown to free it; landing = a needle sweeps a gauge at the end, tap in the gold for +25% value.
